paragraphs.text: Over the last 20 years, the number of children being driven to school in England has doubled. National data suggests that one in five cars on the road at 8.50 am is engaged in the school run. Children are subject to up to 3.9 times more pollution in a car that is standing in traffic than when walking or cycling to school. Reducing cars around schools makes them safer places, and walking and cycling are better for health and the environment. It has been noted by teachers that children engaging in active travel arrive at school more alert and ready to learn.
paragraphs.translation:
在过去的20年里，英格兰由家长开车送去上学的儿童数量翻了一番。
全国数据显示，早上8点50分在路上行驶的汽车中，有五分之一正在执行接送学生的任务。
与步行或骑自行车上学相比，孩子们在堵车的汽车中受到的污染程度高达3.9倍。
减少学校周边的汽车数量能让学校更安全，而步行和骑自行车更有利于健康和环境。
老师们注意到，选择主动出行方式上学的孩子到校时更加警觉，更愿意投入学习。

paragraphs.text: The County Council has a strong commitment to supporting and promoting sustainable school travel. We collect data annually about how pupils get to school, and our report on the Sustainable School Travel Strategy sets out in detail what we have achieved so far and what we intend to do in the future. Different parts of the County Council are working together to address the actions identified in the strategy, and we are proud that we have been able to reduce the number of cars on the daily school run by an average of 1% in each of the last three years, which is equivalent to taking approximately 175 cars off the road annually, despite an increase in pupil numbers.
paragraphs.translation:
郡议会坚定致力于支持和推广可持续的学校出行方式。
我们每年收集关于学生如何上学的数据，而我们的《可持续学校出行战略》报告详细阐述了迄今为止取得的成就以及未来计划采取的行动。
郡议会的不同部门正协同合作，落实战略中确定的各项行动，我们感到自豪的是，尽管学生人数有所增加，但在过去三年中，每年日常接送学生的车辆数量平均减少了1%，这相当于每年减少约175辆车上路。

paragraphs.text: All schools have a School Travel Plan, which sets out how the school and the Council can collaborate to help reduce travel to school by car and encourage the use of public transport. Contact your school to find out what they are doing as part of their School Travel Plan to help you get your child to school in a sustainable, safe way.
paragraphs.translation:
所有学校都制定了一份学校出行计划，该计划阐述了学校和地方议会如何合作，以帮助减少驾车上学的情况，并鼓励使用公共交通。
请联系您孩子的学校，了解他们作为学校出行计划的一部分正在采取哪些措施，以帮助您以可持续且安全的方式送孩子上学。

paragraphs.text: Flu: the facts
paragraphs.translation: 流感：事实

paragraphs.text: A
Flu (influenza) is an acute viral respiratory infection. It spreads easily from person to person: at home, at school, at work, at the supermarket or on the train.
paragraphs.translation:
流感是一种急性病毒性呼吸道感染。
它很容易在人与人之间传播：在家里、学校、工作场所、超市或火车上。
流感（流行性感冒）是一种急性病毒性呼吸道感染。
它在人与人之间很容易传播：无论是在家中、学校、工作场所、超市还是火车上。

paragraphs.text: B
It gets passed on when someone who already has flu coughs or sneezes and is transmitted through the air by droplets, or it can be spread by hands infected by the virus.
paragraphs.translation: 当已感染流感的人咳嗽或打喷嚏时，病毒会通过空气中的飞沫传播，或者通过被病毒污染的手来扩散。

paragraphs.text: C

Symptoms can include fever, chills, headache, muscle pain, extreme fatigue, a dry cough, sore throat and stuffy nose. Most people will recover within a week but flu can cause severe illness or even death in people at high risk. It is estimated that 18,500-24,800 deaths in England and Wales are attributable to influenza infections annually.
paragraphs.translation:
症状可能包括发烧、寒战、头痛、肌肉疼痛、极度疲劳、干咳、喉咙痛和鼻塞。
大多数人会在一周内康复，但流感可能导致高风险人群患上严重疾病甚至死亡。
据估计，英格兰和威尔士每年有18,500至24,800人的死亡可归因于流感感染。

paragraphs.text: D

Vaccination is the most effective way to prevent infection. Although anyone can catch flu, certain people are at greater risk from the implications of flu, as their bodies may not be able to fight the virus. If you are over 65 years old, or suffer from asthma, diabetes, or certain other conditions, you are considered at greater risk from flu and the implications can be serious. If you fall into one of these 'at-risk' groups, are pregnant or a carer, you are eligible for a free flu vaccination.
paragraphs.translation:
接种疫苗是预防感染最有效的方式。
尽管任何人都可能感染流感，但某些人群因身体可能无法抵抗病毒，面临更高的流感并发症风险。
如果你年过65岁，或患有哮喘、糖尿病或其他特定疾病，你将被视为流感高危人群，其后果可能十分严重。
如果你属于这些‘高危’群体之一，或是孕妇或护理人员，则有资格免费接种流感疫苗。

paragraphs.text: E
If you are not eligible for a free flu vaccination, you can still protect yourself and those around you from flu by getting a flu vaccination at a local pharmacy.
paragraphs.translation: 如果您没有资格获得免费流感疫苗，您仍然可以通过在本地药房接种流感疫苗来保护自己和周围的人免受流感侵袭。

paragraphs.text: F
About seven to ten days after vaccination, your body makes antibodies that help to protect you against any similar viruses that may infect you. This protection lasts about a year.
paragraphs.translation:
接种疫苗大约七到十天后，你的身体会产生抗体，这些抗体有助于保护你免受任何可能感染的类似病毒的侵害。
接种疫苗大约七到十天后，你的身体会产生抗体，这些抗体有助于保护你免受任何可能感染你的相似病毒的侵害。
这种保护作用持续约一年。

paragraphs.text: G

A flu vaccination contains inactivated, killed virus strains so it can't give you the flu. However, a flu vaccination can take up to two weeks to begin working, so it is possible to catch flu in this period.
paragraphs.translation:
流感疫苗含有灭活的病毒株，因此不会让你患上流感。
然而，流感疫苗可能需要长达两周的时间才能开始发挥作用，因此在这段时间内仍有感染流感的可能性。

paragraphs.text: H
A flu vaccination is designed to protect you against the most common and potent strains of flu circulating so there is a small chance you could catch a strain of flu not contained in the flu vaccine.
paragraphs.translation: 流感疫苗旨在保护你免受流行中最常见和最致命的流感病毒株的侵害，因此仍存在较小可能性你会感染疫苗未包含的流感病毒株。

paragraphs.text: l
The influenza virus is constantly changing and vaccines are developed to protect against the predicted strains each year so it is important to get vaccinated against the latest strains.
paragraphs.translation: 流感病毒不断变异，而疫苗的开发旨在每年针对预测的毒株提供保护，因此接种最新毒株的疫苗至关重要。

paragraphs.text: Speak to your GP or nurse today to book your flu vaccination.
paragraphs.translation: 今天就和你的家庭医生或护士沟通，预约接种流感疫苗。

sentence_translations.sentence: It spreads easily from person to person: at home, at school, at work, at the supermarket or on the train.
sentence_translations.translation: 它在人与人之间很容易传播：无论是在家中、学校、工作场所、超市还是火车上。

sentence_translations.sentence: It gets passed on when someone who already has flu coughs or sneezes and is transmitted through the air by droplets, or it can be spread by hands infected by the virus.
sentence_translations.translation: 当已感染流感的人咳嗽或打喷嚏时，病毒会通过空气中的飞沫传播，或者通过被病毒污染的手来扩散。

sentence_translations.sentence: Symptoms can include fever, chills, headache, muscle pain, extreme fatigue, a dry cough, sore throat and stuffy nose.
sentence_translations.translation: 症状可能包括发烧、寒战、头痛、肌肉疼痛、极度疲劳、干咳、喉咙痛和鼻塞。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most people will recover within a week but flu can cause severe illness or even death in people at high risk.
sentence_translations.translation: 大多数人会在一周内康复，但流感可能导致高风险人群患上严重疾病甚至死亡。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is estimated that 18,500-24,800 deaths in England and Wales are attributable to influenza infections annually.
sentence_translations.translation: 据估计，英格兰和威尔士每年有18,500至24,800人的死亡可归因于流感感染。

sentence_translations.sentence: Vaccination is the most effective way to prevent infection.
sentence_translations.translation: 接种疫苗是预防感染最有效的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Although anyone can catch flu, certain people are at greater risk from the implications of flu, as their bodies may not be able to fight the virus.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管任何人都可能感染流感，但某些人群因身体可能无法抵抗病毒，面临更高的流感并发症风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are over 65 years old, or suffer from asthma, diabetes, or certain other conditions, you are considered at greater risk from flu and the implications can be serious.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你年过65岁，或患有哮喘、糖尿病或其他特定疾病，你将被视为流感高危人群，其后果可能十分严重。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you fall into one of these 'at-risk' groups, are pregnant or a carer, you are eligible for a free flu vaccination.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你属于这些‘高危’群体之一，或是孕妇或护理人员，则有资格免费接种流感疫苗。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are not eligible for a free flu vaccination, you can still protect yourself and those around you from flu by getting a flu vaccination at a local pharmacy.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您没有资格获得免费流感疫苗，您仍然可以通过在本地药房接种流感疫苗来保护自己和周围的人免受流感侵袭。

sentence_translations.sentence: About seven to ten days after vaccination, your body makes antibodies that help to protect you against any similar viruses that may infect you.
sentence_translations.translation: 接种疫苗大约七到十天后，你的身体会产生抗体，这些抗体有助于保护你免受任何可能感染的类似病毒的侵害。

sentence_translations.sentence: About seven to ten days after vaccination, your body makes antibodies that help to protect you against any similar viruses that may infect you.
sentence_translations.translation: 接种疫苗大约七到十天后，你的身体会产生抗体，这些抗体有助于保护你免受任何可能感染你的相似病毒的侵害。

sentence_translations.sentence: This protection lasts about a year.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种保护作用持续约一年。

sentence_translations.sentence: A flu vaccination contains inactivated, killed virus strains so it can't give you the flu.
sentence_translations.translation: 流感疫苗含有灭活的病毒株，因此不会让你患上流感。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, a flu vaccination can take up to two weeks to begin working, so it is possible to catch flu in this period.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，流感疫苗可能需要长达两周的时间才能开始发挥作用，因此在这段时间内仍有感染流感的可能性。

sentence_translations.sentence: A flu vaccination is designed to protect you against the most common and potent strains of flu circulating so there is a small chance you could catch a strain of flu not contained in the flu vaccine.
sentence_translations.translation: 流感疫苗旨在保护你免受流行中最常见和最致命的流感病毒株的侵害，因此仍存在较小可能性你会感染疫苗未包含的流感病毒株。

sentence_translations.sentence: The influenza virus is constantly changing and vaccines are developed to protect against the predicted strains each year so it is important to get vaccinated against the latest strains.
sentence_translations.translation: 流感病毒不断变异，而疫苗的开发旨在每年针对预测的毒株提供保护，因此接种最新毒株的疫苗至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Speak to your GP or nurse today to book your flu vaccination.
sentence_translations.translation: 今天就和你的家庭医生或护士沟通，预约接种流感疫苗。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Tips for giving an effective business presentation

paragraphs.text: Preparation
paragraphs.translation: 准备工作

paragraphs.text: Get someone else to evaluate your performance and highlight your best skills. For example, go through your presentation in front of a colleague or relative. Think about who your audience is and what you want them to get out of the presentation. Think about content and style.
paragraphs.translation:
请他人评估你的表现并突出你最好的技能。
例如，在同事或亲戚面前演练你的演示。
思考你的听众是谁以及你希望他们从演示中获得什么。
思考内容和风格。

paragraphs.text: Go into the presentation room and try out any moves you may have to make, e.g.getting up from your chair and moving to the podium. Errors in the first 20 seconds can be very disorientating.
paragraphs.translation:
进入演示房间，并尝试你可能需要做出的任何动作，例如从椅子上站起来并走到讲台前。
前20秒内的错误可能会导致非常严重的混乱。

paragraphs.text: Familiarise yourself with the electronic equipment before the presentation and also have a backup plan in mind, should there be an unexpected problem like a power cut.
paragraphs.translation: 在演示前熟悉电子设备，同时心中有一个备用计划，以防出现类似断电的意外问题。

paragraphs.text: Dealing with presentation nervousness
paragraphs.translation: 应对演讲紧张情绪

paragraphs.text: A certain amount of nervousness is vital for a good presentation. The added adrenaline will keep your faculties sharp and give your presentation skills extra force. This can, however, result in tension in the upper chest. Concentrate on your breathing. Slow it right down and this will relax you. Strangely, having something to pick up and put down tends to help you do this.
paragraphs.translation:
一定程度的紧张对于一场成功的演示至关重要。
额外的肾上腺素会让你的思维保持敏锐，并赋予你的演示技巧额外的力量。
然而，这可能会导致上胸部出现紧张感。
专注于你的呼吸。
将呼吸放慢下来，这会使你放松。
奇怪的是，手里有东西可以拿起又放下往往能帮助你做到这一点。

paragraphs.text: It may seem an odd idea, but we seem to feel calmer when we engage in what's referred to as a displacement activity, like clicking a pen or fiddling with jewellery. A limited amount of this will not be too obvious and can make you feel more secure at the start.
paragraphs.translation:
这或许看似一个奇怪的想法，但当我们进行所谓的替代性活动（例如按动笔或摆弄首饰）时，似乎会感到更加平静。
适度进行这种活动不会太明显，还能让你在开始时感到更安心。

paragraphs.text: Interacting with your audience
paragraphs.translation: 与听众互动

paragraphs.text: Think of your presentation as a conversation with your audience. They may not actually say anything, but make them feel consulted, questioned, challenged, then they will stay awake and attentive.
paragraphs.translation:
将你的演示视为与观众的一次对话。
他们可能实际上不会说任何话，但要让他们感到被咨询、被质疑、被挑战，这样他们就会保持清醒和专注。

paragraphs.text: Engage with your present audience, not the one you have prepared for. Keep looking for reactions to your ideas and respond to them. If your audience doesn't appear to be following you, find another way to get your ideas across. If you don 't interact, you might as well send a video recording of your presentation instead!
paragraphs.translation:
与你在场的观众互动，而不是你为之准备的那群人。
持续寻找观众对你观点的反应，并据此做出回应。
如果你的观众似乎没有跟上你的思路，那就另找方法传达你的观点。
如果你不进行互动，倒不如直接发送你演讲的视频录像！

paragraphs.text: Structuring effective presentations
paragraphs.translation: 构建有效的演示文稿结构

paragraphs.text: Effective presentations are full of examples. These help your listeners to see more clearly what you mean. It's quicker and more colourful. Stick to the point using three or four main ideas. For any subsidiary information that you cannot present in 20 minutes, try another medium, such as handouts.
paragraphs.translation:
有效的演示充满实例。
它们帮助听众更清楚地理解你的意思。
这样更快捷，也更生动。
围绕三到四个主要观点，紧扣主题。
对于任何无法在20分钟内呈现的辅助信息，尝试改用其他媒介，比如讲义。

paragraphs.text: End as if your presentation has gone well. Do this even if you feel you've presented badly. And anyway a good finish will get you some applause - and you deserve it!
paragraphs.translation:
结束时要表现得好像你的演讲进行得很顺利。
即使你觉得自己讲得很糟糕，也要这样做。
而且无论如何，一个出色的结尾会为你赢得一些掌声——而你值得拥有这些掌声！

paragraphs.text: How to get a job in journalism
paragraphs.translation: 如何在新闻行业找到一份工作

paragraphs.text: You can get a good qualification in journalism, but what employers actually want is practical, rather than theoretical, knowledge. There's no substitute for creating real stories that have to be handed in by strict deadlines. So write for your school magazine, then maybe try your hand at editing. Once you've done that for a while, start requesting internships in newspapers in the area. These are generally short-term and unpaid, but they're definitely worthwhile, since, instead of providing you with money, they'll teach you the skills that every twenty-first century journalist has to have, like laying out articles, creating web pages, taking good digital pictures and so on.
paragraphs.translation:
你可以获得新闻学方面的优秀资质，但雇主真正想要的是实践知识，而非理论知识。
没有什么能替代创作必须在严格截稿时间前提交的真实报道。
因此，先为校刊撰稿，然后或许尝试一下编辑工作。
这些实习通常短期且无薪，但绝对值得，因为它们不会给你金钱，而是会教给你每个21世纪记者必备的技能，比如编排文章、创建网页、拍摄高质量数码照片等等。

paragraphs.text: Most reporters keep a copy of every story they've had published, from secondary school onwards. They're called cuttings, and you need them to get a job - indeed a few impressive ones can be the deciding factor in whether you're appointed or not. So start creating a portfolio now that will show off your developing talent.
paragraphs.translation:
大多数记者都会保留自己从中学开始发表过的每一篇文章的副本。
这些东西被称为剪报，而你需要它们来获得一份工作——实际上，几篇令人印象深刻的剪报可能成为你是否被录用的决定性因素。
因此，现在就开始创建一个能展示你不断成长的才华的作品集吧。

paragraphs.text: It seems obvious - research is an important part of an effective job hunt. But it's surprising how many would-be journalists do little or none. If you're thorough, it can help you decide whether the job you're thinking about applying for is right for you. And nothing impresses an editor more than an applicant who knows a lot about the paper.
paragraphs.translation:
这似乎是显而易见的——研究是有效求职的重要组成部分。
但令人惊讶的是，许多准记者很少或根本不进行调查研究。
如果你做事周全，这能帮助你判断你正在考虑申请的工作是否适合你。
而且，没有什么比一位对报纸了解颇深的求职者更能给编辑留下深刻印象了。

paragraphs.text: There are two more elements to an application - your covering letter and curriculum vitae. However, your CV is the thing that will attract an editor's attention first, so get it right. The key words are brevity, (no more than one page) accuracy (absolutely no spelling or typing errors) and clarity (it should be easy to follow).
paragraphs.translation:
申请材料中还有另外两个要素——你的求职信和个人简历。
然而，你的简历是首先吸引编辑注意力的东西，所以务必把它做好。
关键词是简洁（不超过一页）、准确（绝无拼写或打字错误）和清晰（应该易于理解）。

paragraphs.text: In journalism, good writing skills are essential, so it's critical that the style of your letter is appropriate. And, make sure it conveys your love of journalism and your eagerness to do the work.
paragraphs.translation:
在新闻行业，良好的写作技能至关重要，因此确保你的信件风格得体十分关键。
此外，务必让信件传达出你对新闻工作的热爱以及从事这份工作的热切渴望。

parts.source_article_title: Tips for giving an effective business presentation

sentence_translations.sentence: Preparation
sentence_translations.translation: 准备工作

sentence_translations.sentence: Get someone else to evaluate your performance and highlight your best skills.
sentence_translations.translation: 请他人评估你的表现并突出你最好的技能。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, go through your presentation in front of a colleague or relative.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，在同事或亲戚面前演练你的演示。

sentence_translations.sentence: Think about who your audience is and what you want them to get out of the presentation.
sentence_translations.translation: 思考你的听众是谁以及你希望他们从演示中获得什么。

sentence_translations.sentence: Think about content and style.
sentence_translations.translation: 思考内容和风格。

sentence_translations.sentence: Go into the presentation room and try out any moves you may have to make, e.g. getting up from your chair and moving to the podium.
sentence_translations.translation: 进入演示房间，并尝试你可能需要做出的任何动作，例如从椅子上站起来并走到讲台前。

sentence_translations.sentence: Errors in the first 20 seconds can be very disorientating.
sentence_translations.translation: 前20秒内的错误可能会导致非常严重的混乱。

sentence_translations.sentence: Familiarise yourself with the electronic equipment before the presentation and also have a backup plan in mind, should there be an unexpected problem like a power cut.
sentence_translations.translation: 在演示前熟悉电子设备，同时心中有一个备用计划，以防出现类似断电的意外问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: Dealing with presentation nervousness
sentence_translations.translation: 应对演讲紧张情绪

sentence_translations.sentence: A certain amount of nervousness is vital for a good presentation.
sentence_translations.translation: 一定程度的紧张对于一场成功的演示至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: The added adrenaline will keep your faculties sharp and give your presentation skills extra force.
sentence_translations.translation: 额外的肾上腺素会让你的思维保持敏锐，并赋予你的演示技巧额外的力量。

sentence_translations.sentence: This can, however, result in tension in the upper chest.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，这可能会导致上胸部出现紧张感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Concentrate on your breathing.
sentence_translations.translation: 专注于你的呼吸。

sentence_translations.sentence: Slow it right down and this will relax you.
sentence_translations.translation: 将呼吸放慢下来，这会使你放松。

sentence_translations.sentence: Strangely, having something to pick up and put down tends to help you do this.
sentence_translations.translation: 奇怪的是，手里有东西可以拿起又放下往往能帮助你做到这一点。

sentence_translations.sentence: It may seem an odd idea, but we seem to feel calmer when we engage in what's referred to as a displacement activity, like clicking a pen or fiddling with jewellery.
sentence_translations.translation: 这或许看似一个奇怪的想法，但当我们进行所谓的替代性活动（例如按动笔或摆弄首饰）时，似乎会感到更加平静。

sentence_translations.sentence: A limited amount of this will not be too obvious and can make you feel more secure at the start.
sentence_translations.translation: 适度进行这种活动不会太明显，还能让你在开始时感到更安心。

sentence_translations.sentence: Interacting with your audience
sentence_translations.translation: 与听众互动

sentence_translations.sentence: Think of your presentation as a conversation with your audience.
sentence_translations.translation: 将你的演示视为与观众的一次对话。

sentence_translations.sentence: They may not actually say anything, but make them feel consulted, questioned, challenged, then they will stay awake and attentive.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们可能实际上不会说任何话，但要让他们感到被咨询、被质疑、被挑战，这样他们就会保持清醒和专注。

sentence_translations.sentence: Engage with your present audience, not the one you have prepared for.
sentence_translations.translation: 与你在场的观众互动，而不是你为之准备的那群人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Keep looking for reactions to your ideas and respond to them.
sentence_translations.translation: 持续寻找观众对你观点的反应，并据此做出回应。

sentence_translations.sentence: If your audience doesn't appear to be following you, find another way to get your ideas across.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你的观众似乎没有跟上你的思路，那就另找方法传达你的观点。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you don 't interact, you might as well send a video recording of your presentation instead!
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你不进行互动，倒不如直接发送你演讲的视频录像！

sentence_translations.sentence: Structuring effective presentations
sentence_translations.translation: 构建有效的演示文稿结构

sentence_translations.sentence: Effective presentations are full of examples.
sentence_translations.translation: 有效的演示充满实例。

sentence_translations.sentence: These help your listeners to see more clearly what you mean.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们帮助听众更清楚地理解你的意思。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's quicker and more colourful.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样更快捷，也更生动。

sentence_translations.sentence: Stick to the point using three or four main ideas.
sentence_translations.translation: 围绕三到四个主要观点，紧扣主题。

sentence_translations.sentence: For any subsidiary information that you cannot present in 20 minutes, try another medium, such as handouts.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于任何无法在20分钟内呈现的辅助信息，尝试改用其他媒介，比如讲义。

sentence_translations.sentence: End as if your presentation has gone well.
sentence_translations.translation: 结束时要表现得好像你的演讲进行得很顺利。

sentence_translations.sentence: Do this even if you feel you've presented badly.
sentence_translations.translation: 即使你觉得自己讲得很糟糕，也要这样做。

sentence_translations.sentence: And anyway a good finish will get you some applause - and you deserve it!
sentence_translations.translation: 而且无论如何，一个出色的结尾会为你赢得一些掌声——而你值得拥有这些掌声！

sentence_translations.sentence: How to get a job in journalism
sentence_translations.translation: 如何在新闻行业找到一份工作

sentence_translations.sentence: You can get a good qualification in journalism, but what employers actually want is practical, rather than theoretical, knowledge.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以获得新闻学方面的优秀资质，但雇主真正想要的是实践知识，而非理论知识。

sentence_translations.sentence: There's no substitute for creating real stories that have to be handed in by strict deadlines.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有什么能替代创作必须在严格截稿时间前提交的真实报道。

sentence_translations.sentence: So write for your school magazine, then maybe try your hand at editing.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，先为校刊撰稿，然后或许尝试一下编辑工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: These are generally short-term and unpaid, but they're definitely worthwhile, since, instead of providing you with money, they'll teach you the skills that every twenty-first century journalist has to have, like laying out articles, creating web pages, taking good digital pictures and so on.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些实习通常短期且无薪，但绝对值得，因为它们不会给你金钱，而是会教给你每个21世纪记者必备的技能，比如编排文章、创建网页、拍摄高质量数码照片等等。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most reporters keep a copy of every story they've had published, from secondary school onwards.
sentence_translations.translation: 大多数记者都会保留自己从中学开始发表过的每一篇文章的副本。

sentence_translations.sentence: They're called cuttings, and you need them to get a job - indeed a few impressive ones can be the deciding factor in whether you're appointed or not.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些东西被称为剪报，而你需要它们来获得一份工作——实际上，几篇令人印象深刻的剪报可能成为你是否被录用的决定性因素。

sentence_translations.sentence: So start creating a portfolio now that will show off your developing talent.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，现在就开始创建一个能展示你不断成长的才华的作品集吧。

sentence_translations.sentence: It seems obvious - research is an important part of an effective job hunt.
sentence_translations.translation: 这似乎是显而易见的——研究是有效求职的重要组成部分。

sentence_translations.sentence: But it's surprising how many would-be journalists do little or none.
sentence_translations.translation: 但令人惊讶的是，许多准记者很少或根本不进行调查研究。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're thorough, it can help you decide whether the job you're thinking about applying for is right for you.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你做事周全，这能帮助你判断你正在考虑申请的工作是否适合你。

sentence_translations.sentence: And nothing impresses an editor more than an applicant who knows a lot about the paper.
sentence_translations.translation: 而且，没有什么比一位对报纸了解颇深的求职者更能给编辑留下深刻印象了。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are two more elements to an application - your covering letter and curriculum vitae.
sentence_translations.translation: 申请材料中还有另外两个要素——你的求职信和个人简历。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, your CV is the thing that will attract an editor's attention first, so get it right.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，你的简历是首先吸引编辑注意力的东西，所以务必把它做好。

sentence_translations.sentence: The key words are brevity, (no more than one page) accuracy (absolutely no spelling or typing errors) and clarity (it should be easy to follow).
sentence_translations.translation: 关键词是简洁（不超过一页）、准确（绝无拼写或打字错误）和清晰（应该易于理解）。

sentence_translations.sentence: In journalism, good writing skills are essential, so it's critical that the style of your letter is appropriate.
sentence_translations.translation: 在新闻行业，良好的写作技能至关重要，因此确保你的信件风格得体十分关键。

sentence_translations.sentence: And, make sure it conveys your love of journalism and your eagerness to do the work.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，务必让信件传达出你对新闻工作的热爱以及从事这份工作的热切渴望。

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: What is it like to run a large supermarket?

paragraphs.text: Jill Insley finds out
paragraphs.translation: 吉尔·因斯利一探究竟

paragraphs.text: A

You can't beat really good service. I've been shopping in the Thamesmead branch of supermarket chain Morrisons, in south-east London, and I've experienced at first hand, the store's latest maxim for improving the shopping experience - help, offer, thank. This involves identifying customers who might need help, greeting them, asking what they need, providing it, thanking them and leaving them in peace. If they don't look like they want help, they'll be left alone. But if they're standing looking lost and perplexed, a member of staff will approach them. Staff are expected to be friendly to everyone. My checkout assistant has certainly said something to amuse the woman in front of me, she's smiling as she leaves. Adrian Perriss, manager of the branch, has discussed the approach with each of his 387 staff. He says it's about recognising that someone needs help, not being a nuisance to them. When he's in another store, he's irritated by someone saying, 'Can I help you?' when he's only just walked in to have a quick look at the products.
paragraphs.translation:
没有什么能比得上真正优质的服务。
我一直在伦敦东南部莫里森超市连锁店的泰晤士米德分店购物，并亲身经历了该店改善购物体验的最新准则——帮助、提供、感谢。
这包括识别可能需要帮助的顾客，向他们打招呼，询问他们的需求，提供帮助，感谢他们，然后让他们自在地购物。
如果他们看起来不需要帮助，就不会被打扰。
但如果他们站着看上去迷茫困惑，工作人员就会上前询问。
员工应对所有人都保持友好。
我的收银员确实说了些什么逗乐了我前面那位女士，她离开时面带微笑。
该分店经理阿德里安·佩里斯已与他的387名员工逐一讨论了这种方法。
他说，这关乎识别某人需要帮助，而不是给他们添麻烦。
当他在其他商店时，他刚走进去想快速看看商品，就有人问‘需要帮忙吗？’，这让他感到恼火。

paragraphs.text: B

How anyone can be friendly and enthusiastic when they start work at dawn beats me. The store opens at 7 am, Monday to Saturday, meaning that some staff, including Perriss, have to be here at 6 am to make sure it's clean, safe and stocked up for the morning rush. Sometimes he walks in at 6 am and thinks they're never going to be ready on time - but they always are. There's so much going on overnight - 20 people working on unloading three enormous trailers full of groceries.
paragraphs.translation:
我难以理解，人们如何在黎明时分开始工作时还能保持友好和热情。
我真想不明白，有人怎么能在黎明时分开始工作时还保持友好和热情。
我真不明白，怎么会有人在拂晓时分开始工作时还能如此友善热情。
这家店周一至周六早上7点开门，这意味着包括佩里斯在内的一些员工必须在早上6点到岗，确保店面清洁、安全，并为早高峰备好货。
有时他早上6点走进店里，会以为他们永远无法按时准备好——但他们总能做到。
夜间有大量工作要做——20个人忙着卸下三辆装满杂货的大型拖车。

paragraphs.text: C

Perriss has worked in supermarkets since 1982, when he became a trolley boy on a weekly salary of 76. 'It was less money than my previous job, but I loved it. It was different and diverse. I was doing trolleys, portering, bread, cakes, dairy and general maintenance.' After a period in the produce department, looking after the fruit and vegetables, he was made produce manager, then assistant store manager, before reaching the top job in 1998. This involved intensive training and assessment through the company's future store manager programme, learning how to analyse and prioritise sales, wastage, recruitment and many other issues. Perriss' first stop as store manager was at a store which was closed soon afterwards - though he was not to blame.
paragraphs.translation:
Perriss自1982年起就在超市工作，当时他是一名手推车服务生，周薪为76英镑。
“这比我之前的工作收入少，但我热爱它。”
这份工作与众不同且多样化。
我负责手推车、搬运、面包、蛋糕、乳制品和一般维护工作。”
在农产品部门工作一段时间，负责水果和蔬菜后，他被晋升为农产品经理，随后成为助理店长，最终在1998年担任最高职位。
这包括通过公司的未来店长项目接受密集培训和评估，学习如何分析并优先处理销售、损耗、招聘及许多其他问题。
Perriss作为店长的第一站是一家不久后关闭的商店——尽管并非他的过错。
佩里斯自1982年起就在超市工作，当时他是一名每周薪水76便士的推车工。
'这份工作的薪水比我之前的工作少，但我很喜欢。
我当时负责推车、搬运、面包、蛋糕、乳制品以及一般维护工作。'
在生鲜部门工作一段时间，负责水果和蔬菜后，他被提拔为生鲜经理，随后成为助理店经理，最终在1998年达到了店经理的最高职位。
这需要通过公司未来店经理项目进行密集的培训和评估，学习如何分析和优先处理销售、损耗、招聘以及许多其他问题。
佩里斯作为店经理的第一站是一家不久后被关闭的店铺——尽管这并不是他的过错。
佩里斯自1982年起就在超市工作，当时他是一名推车工，周薪为76英镑。
“这份工作比我之前的工作收入少，但我很喜欢。
它不同寻常且多样化。
我负责推车、搬运、面包、蛋糕、乳制品以及一般性维护。”
在生鲜部门工作了一段时间、负责水果和蔬菜后，他被任命为生鲜经理，随后担任助理店经理，最终于1998年晋升为店经理。
这包括通过公司的未来店经理项目接受密集培训和评估，学习如何分析和优先处理销售、损耗、招聘以及许多其他问题。
佩里斯作为店经理的第一站是一家不久后被关闭的店铺——尽管他并不应为此承担责任。

paragraphs.text: D

Despite the disappointing start, his career went from strength to strength and he was put in charge of launching new stores and heading up a 'concept' store, where the then new ideas of preparing and cooking pizzas in store, and having a proper florist, and fruit and vegetable 'markets' were trialled. All Morrisons' managers from the whole country spent three days there to see the new concept. 'That was hard work,' he says,"long days, seven days a week, for about a year."
paragraphs.translation:
尽管开局令人失望，他的职业生涯却越来越成功，并被委以重任，负责开设新门店并领导一家“概念”店，在那里，当时的新理念——如在店内制作和烹饪披萨、设立专业花店以及果蔬“市场”——都得到了试行。
尽管开局令人失望，他的职业生涯却蒸蒸日上，他被委以重任，负责开设新店并管理一家‘概念’店，当时的新理念，包括在店内准备和烹饪披萨、设立正规花店以及果蔬‘市场’，都在那里进行了试点。
来自全国各地的所有莫里森超市经理都在那里花了三天时间参观这一新概念。
‘那工作很辛苦，’他说，‘每天工作时间长，一周七天，持续了大约一年。’
尽管开局令人失望，但他的职业生涯不断壮大，他被委以重任，负责开设新门店并领导一家“概念”店，在那里试行了当时的新理念，即在店内制作和烹饪披萨、设立正规花店以及水果蔬菜“市场”。
全国所有莫里森超市的经理都在那里花了三天时间参观这一新理念。
“那工作很辛苦，”他说，“每天工作时间很长，一周七天，持续了大约一年。”

paragraphs.text: E

Although he oversees a store with a large turnover, there is a strongly practical aspect to Perriss's job. As we walk around, he chats to all the staff while checking the layout of their counters and the quality of the produce. He examines the baking potato shelf and rejects three, one that has split virtually in half and two that are beginning to go green. He then pulls out a lemon that looks fine to me. When I ask why, he picks up a second lemon and says:' Close your eyes and just feel and tell me which you would keep.' I do and realise that while one is firm and hard, the other is going a bit squashy.
paragraphs.translation:
尽管他管理着一家营业额庞大的商店，但佩里斯的工作中有一个非常实际的方面。
当我们四处走动时，他与所有员工交谈，同时检查他们柜台的布局和商品的质量。
他检查了烤土豆货架，挑出了三个有问题的，一个几乎裂成两半，另外两个开始发绿。
然后他拿出一个在我看来很好的柠檬。
当我问为什么时，他拿起第二个柠檬说：“闭上眼睛，用手摸一下，告诉我你会留哪个。”
我照做了，并意识到一个结实而坚硬，而另一个则有点软了。
尽管他管理着一家营业额巨大的超市，但他的工作具有很强的实践性。
他检查了烤土豆货架，并挑出了三个不合格的土豆，一个几乎裂成两半，另外两个开始变绿。
接着，他拿出一个在我看来完好的柠檬。
当我问为什么时，他拿起另一个柠檬说：‘闭上眼睛，只需用手感受，告诉我你会留下哪一个。’
我照做了，然后意识到一个柠檬坚实而硬，而另一个则有点软了。

paragraphs.text: F

Despite eagle-eyed Perriss pulling out fruit and veg that most of us would buy without a second thought, the wastage each week is tiny: produce worth £4,200 is marked down for a quick sale, and only £400-worth is scrapped. This, he explains, is down to Morrisons' method of ordering, still done manually rather than by computer. parts.source_article_title: What is it like to run a large supermarket?

sentence_translations.sentence: Jill Insley finds out
sentence_translations.translation: 吉尔·因斯利一探究竟

sentence_translations.sentence: Despite the disappointing start, his career went from strength to strength and he was put in charge of launching new stores and heading up a 'concept' store, where the then new ideas of preparing and cooking pizzas in store, and having a proper florist, and fruit and vegetable 'markets' were trialled.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管开局令人失望，他的职业生涯却越来越成功，并被委以重任，负责开设新门店并领导一家“概念”店，在那里，当时的新理念——如在店内制作和烹饪披萨、设立专业花店以及果蔬“市场”——都得到了试行。

sentence_translations.sentence: His favourite department is fish, which has a 4 m-long counter run by Debbie and Angela, who are busy having a discussion about how to cook a particular fish with a customer.
sentence_translations.translation: 他最喜欢的部门是鱼类区，那里有一个由黛比和安吉拉负责的4米长的柜台，她们正忙着与一位顾客讨论如何烹饪某种特定的鱼。

sentence_translations.sentence: But it is one of just 20 or so departments around the store and Perriss admits the pressure of making sure he knows what's happening on them all can be intense.
sentence_translations.translation: 但这只是店里大约20个部门中的一个，佩里斯承认，要确保自己了解所有部门的情况，压力可能很大。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'You have to do so much and there could be something wrong with every single one, every day,' he says.
sentence_translations.translation: “你必须做很多事情，而且每一天每个部门都可能出现问题，”他说。

sentence_translations.sentence: You've got to minimise those things and shrink them into perspective.
sentence_translations.translation: 你必须尽量减少这些问题，并从全局角度看待它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: You've got to love the job.'
sentence_translations.translation: 你必须热爱这份工作。”

sentence_translations.sentence: And Perriss certainly does.
sentence_translations.translation: 而佩里斯当然热爱这份工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can't beat really good service.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有什么能比得上真正优质的服务。

sentence_translations.sentence: I've been shopping in the Thamesmead branch of supermarket chain Morrisons, in south-east London, and I've experienced at first hand, the store's latest maxim for improving the shopping experience - help, offer, thank.
sentence_translations.translation: 我一直在伦敦东南部莫里森超市连锁店的泰晤士米德分店购物，并亲身经历了该店改善购物体验的最新准则——帮助、提供、感谢。

sentence_translations.sentence: This involves identifying customers who might need help, greeting them, asking what they need, providing it, thanking them and leaving them in peace.
sentence_translations.translation: 这包括识别可能需要帮助的顾客，向他们打招呼，询问他们的需求，提供帮助，感谢他们，然后让他们自在地购物。

sentence_translations.sentence: If they don't look like they want help, they'll be left alone.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果他们看起来不需要帮助，就不会被打扰。

sentence_translations.sentence: But if they're standing looking lost and perplexed, a member of staff will approach them.
sentence_translations.translation: 但如果他们站着看上去迷茫困惑，工作人员就会上前询问。

sentence_translations.sentence: Staff are expected to be friendly to everyone.
sentence_translations.translation: 员工应对所有人都保持友好。

sentence_translations.sentence: My checkout assistant has certainly said something to amuse the woman in front of me, she's smiling as she leaves.
sentence_translations.translation: 我的收银员确实说了些什么逗乐了我前面那位女士，她离开时面带微笑。

sentence_translations.sentence: Adrian Perriss, manager of the branch, has discussed the approach with each of his 387 staff.
sentence_translations.translation: 该分店经理阿德里安·佩里斯已与他的387名员工逐一讨论了这种方法。

sentence_translations.sentence: He says it's about recognising that someone needs help, not being a nuisance to them.
sentence_translations.translation: 他说，这关乎识别某人需要帮助，而不是给他们添麻烦。

sentence_translations.sentence: When he's in another store, he's irritated by someone saying, 'Can I help you?' when he's only just walked in to have a quick look at the products.
sentence_translations.translation: 当他在其他商店时，他刚走进去想快速看看商品，就有人问‘需要帮忙吗？’，这让他感到恼火。

sentence_translations.sentence: How anyone can be friendly and enthusiastic when they start work at dawn beats me.
sentence_translations.translation: 我难以理解，人们如何在黎明时分开始工作时还能保持友好和热情。

sentence_translations.sentence: How anyone can be friendly and enthusiastic when they start work at dawn beats me.
sentence_translations.translation: 我真想不明白，有人怎么能在黎明时分开始工作时还保持友好和热情。

sentence_translations.sentence: How anyone can be friendly and enthusiastic when they start work at dawn beats me.
sentence_translations.translation: 我真不明白，怎么会有人在拂晓时分开始工作时还能如此友善热情。

sentence_translations.sentence: The store opens at 7 am, Monday to Saturday, meaning that some staff, including Perriss, have to be here at 6 am to make sure it's clean, safe and stocked up for the morning rush.
sentence_translations.translation: 这家店周一至周六早上7点开门，这意味着包括佩里斯在内的一些员工必须在早上6点到岗，确保店面清洁、安全，并为早高峰备好货。

sentence_translations.sentence: Sometimes he walks in at 6 am and thinks they're never going to be ready on time - but they always are.
sentence_translations.translation: 有时他早上6点走进店里，会以为他们永远无法按时准备好——但他们总能做到。

sentence_translations.sentence: There's so much going on overnight - 20 people working on unloading three enormous trailers full of groceries.
sentence_translations.translation: 夜间有大量工作要做——20个人忙着卸下三辆装满杂货的大型拖车。

sentence_translations.translation: Perriss自1982年起就在超市工作，当时他是一名手推车服务生，周薪为76英镑。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'It was less money than my previous job, but I loved it.
sentence_translations.translation: “这比我之前的工作收入少，但我热爱它。”

sentence_translations.sentence: It was different and diverse.
sentence_translations.translation: 这份工作与众不同且多样化。

sentence_translations.sentence: I was doing trolleys, portering, bread, cakes, dairy and general maintenance.'
sentence_translations.translation: 我负责手推车、搬运、面包、蛋糕、乳制品和一般维护工作。”

sentence_translations.sentence: After a period in the produce department, looking after the fruit and vegetables, he was made produce manager, then assistant store manager, before reaching the top job in 1998.
sentence_translations.translation: 在农产品部门工作一段时间，负责水果和蔬菜后，他被晋升为农产品经理，随后成为助理店长，最终在1998年担任最高职位。

sentence_translations.translation: 这包括通过公司的未来店长项目接受密集培训和评估，学习如何分析并优先处理销售、损耗、招聘及许多其他问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: To help him, he has a key team of four, who each have direct responsibility for different departments.
